name: The Masked Figure
bio: Nobody has seen his face. Nobody wants to.
notes: Drive intake of 2026-11-05 ("The Masked Figure", rigged and animated on Meshy (Mixamo joint names read as Meshy's; finger chains, where it has them, folded into the hands and refitted by hands.mjs; its clips not used)).
